note: Synthetic voice cases for the quick_response measures (items.id=899 stage 3). Every name, number and organisation is invented. A refine case has no draft: the step writes guidance from the profile and the document type's settings.

Renata

Small towns should keep their paper public notice boards. Even when the council also posts notices online, a board in the library or the post office is read by people who never visit the council website. Online-only notices leave out residents without a home internet connection, and they are the ones most likely to miss a change to the bus timetable or a planning notice. A paper board costs little and reaches them.

points.text: Residents without home internet are left out
